name: auth-layout
description: Authentication surface with a centered card or a split form/aside layout, plus brand, title, footer and size presets.
designIntent: Sign-in, sign-up, reset and verify screens should look identical. AuthLayout owns the centered card (or the split form/aside shell), brand slot and footer so auth pages only supply the form. The split variant keeps DOM order form then aside and stacks below the form on mobile.

props.name: variant
props.description: Layout preset. Split adds a branded aside beside the form card on desktop and below it on mobile.

props.name: aside
props.description: Optional panel rendered beside the card in the split variant. Ignored when centered; omitting it falls back to centered.
